proxy.scope: The proxy covers in-app API, audio, images, video and authorized downloads. Changes apply to subsequent requests; existing streams keep their connections. Off connects directly. Updates and external browsers connect separately. Testing checks one Go request.
proxy.unsupported: Settings saved, but the application network gateway is not ready.
proxy.partial: Settings applied to API and media requests. Authorized downloads are not ready.
proxy.applied: Proxy applied to API, media and authorized downloads.
proxy.restart: Settings saved and will take effect on the next launch.
proxy.web_unapplied: API and media proxy: not applied yet.
proxy.downloads_unapplied: Authorized download proxy: not applied yet.
proxy.invalid: Choose HTTP or HTTPS, enter a hostname or IP address and an integer port from 1 to 65535. Credentials are not supported.
proxy.load_failed: Could not read the saved proxy settings.
proxy.save_failed: Could not save and apply the proxy. Please try again.
